description: Synthetic development benchmark fixed before evaluating Qwen3, BGE-M3 and EmbeddingGemma. Includes related skills and explicit corrections of earlier intent.

skills.name: quote
skills.description: Calculate motor insurance premiums and compare prices for coverage options.

skills.name: coverage
skills.description: 解释保险保障范围、免赔额、责任限额以及除外责任等条款。

skills.name: claim_report
skills.description: Open a new insurance claim after an accident and collect incident evidence.

skills.name: claim_status
skills.description: 查询已提交理赔案件的审核进度、赔款状态和预计处理时间。

skills.name: renew_policy
skills.description: Renew an insurance policy that is approaching its expiry date.

skills.name: cancel_policy
skills.description: 办理保险退保，说明终止保障的流程并核算可退保费。

skills.name: vehicle_change
skills.description: Amend the vehicle details on an existing insurance policy.

skills.name: roadside
skills.description: 安排车辆故障后的道路救援，包括拖车、搭电和紧急换胎。

skills.name: wechat_add
skills.description: Guide a customer through adding the service contact as a WeChat friend.

skills.name: wechat_message
skills.description: 帮助客户在微信内找到已有服务通知、公众号消息或聊天记录。

skills.name: password
skills.description: Reset a forgotten password and restore login credentials.

skills.name: unlock
skills.description: 处理因多次登录失败或风控而被锁定、冻结的账户。

skills.name: delivery
skills.description: Track a shipped parcel and estimate its delivery time.

skills.name: delivery_address
skills.description: 在订单允许修改时更新收货地址或收件人联系方式。

skills.name: return_item
skills.description: Start a product return and provide return shipping instructions.

skills.name: refund_status
skills.description: 查询已经发起的退款是否处理完成以及款项预计到账时间。

skills.name: invoice_new
skills.description: Issue a new invoice for a completed purchase.

skills.name: invoice_fix
skills.description: 更正已开具发票中的抬头、税号或金额，并处理重新开票。

skills.name: appointment_new
skills.description: Book a new vehicle maintenance or repair appointment.

skills.name: appointment_change
skills.description: 修改或取消已有的车辆维修保养预约时间。

skills.name: payment_methods
skills.description: Explain available payment methods and supported payment channels.

skills.name: payment_failed
skills.description: 排查支付失败、扣款异常或付款后订单仍显示未支付的问题。

skills.name: privacy_delete
skills.description: Process requests to delete an account and its stored personal information.

skills.name: human_agent
skills.description: 将对话转接给人工客服或安排人工顾问回电。
